note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status, navigation icon buttons (Home, DMs, etc.), and footer links; the rooms-list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Room header -- renders: channel name (operator-defined for HR announcements), member count, and fixed action buttons (Search, Members, Pinned, etc.)
Message container chrome -- renders: 'New message' button and 'Jump to recent' button; the messages-list is subtracted as it contains user-generated message content
Message input area -- renders: emoji picker, message textarea, and fixed formatting toolbar buttons (Bold, Italic, etc.)
